newsitem.title: CONGO: Zaire's Kabila to meet Mandela in Cape Town.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Kabila to meet Mandela in Cape Town.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila, who torpedoed scheduled peace talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko, will meet South African President Nelson Mandela in South Africa on Thursday, an official said.

"He has indicated that he is committed to continuing the talks," Frank Chikane, an aide to South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki, told reporters on the ship that was to have hosted the Mobutu-Kabila meeting on Wednesday.
Chikane said Mbeki, who has played a central role in South Africa's initiative for peace in Zaire, would remain in Pointe Noire for further discussions with Mobutu's delegation.

He said Mandela talked to Kabila by telephone after the rebel leader, citing security concerns, had refused to board the South African naval vessel in Pointe Noire in Congo, as previously agreed. Kabila's forces control most of Zaire.
Mandela discussed the conversation with Mobutu, who, according to diplomatic sources, had to be roused from bed for the hour-long meeting.
South African officials said Mandela flew home late on Wednesday, probably to Cape Town.
